description: This file is a C++ source file implementing message storage and control management functionalities within the WPEFramework. It includes class definitions, serialization/deserialization methods, and static control registration functions related to messaging metadata, message info, and control handling.

classes.name: Controls
classes.description: Class responsible for managing a list of announced controls, allowing registration, revocation, and iteration over controls.

methods.name: Controls::Controls
methods.description: Constructor for the Controls class, default.

methods.name: Controls::~Controls
methods.description: Destructor that ensures all controls are destroyed and resources are released.

methods.name: Controls::Announce
methods.description: Registers a control object into the control list.

methods.name: Controls::Revoke
methods.description: Removes a control object from the control list.

methods.name: Controls::Iterate
methods.description: Iterates over all registered controls, invoking a handler.

methods.name: ControlsInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the Controls class.
